name: momi-animation-backend
comment: Runs on Node 24 in production (pm2). better-sqlite3 is a native module built for that ABI; if you change the Node major version, run `pnpm rebuild better-sqlite3` or the native binding will fail to load (ERR_DLOPEN_FAILED / NODE_MODULE_VERSION mismatch).
comment:coverage: The --check-coverage thresholds in test:coverage are a regression ratchet, not a target. The 2026-08-04 risk-focused pass measured 78.82/74.44/87.59/78.82; floors remain several points below it so c8 drift and honest refactors do not reward coverage theatre. See docs/COVERAGE_STRATEGY.md. Adding a test that loads a previously-unloaded module can lower a percentage by enlarging the denominator; judge changes by covered counts and risk behavior too.
comment:coverage-exclusions: Two files are excluded because they contain no executable application code, not because they are hard to test. types.ts is pure type declarations and emits no JavaScript at all, so its lines can never be covered by any test. opsDashboardPage.ts is a single exported template literal holding the ops dashboard's static HTML -- importing it once would 'cover' 499 lines without asserting anything, which is coverage theatre. Together they were 769 uncovered lines (~4 points) that no test could ever legitimately reach. Do NOT add exclusions here for code that is merely awkward to test.

scripts.test:coverage: c8 --all --src src --include "src/**/*.ts" --exclude "src/**/*.test.ts" --exclude "src/**/*.integration.test.ts" --exclude "src/topologyLoadTest.ts" --exclude "src/types.ts" --exclude "src/opsDashboardPage.ts" --reporter text-summary --reporter json-summary --reporter lcov --reporter html --report-dir coverage/backend --check-coverage --statements 74 --branches 71 --functions 82 --lines 74 node scripts/runBackendTests.mjs
